# Input

Clear labels and error messages keep every entry on track.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="input" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | undefined | Optional ID for the input element; generated by default |
| `hint` | string | undefined | Helper text linked to the input and kept while an error shows |
| `modelValue` | string | '' | Updated through v-model |
| `label` | string | Required | Visible label |
| `error` | string | undefined | Error message |
| `disabled` | boolean | false | Blocks input |
| `type` | string | 'text' | Native input type |

### Events

- `update:modelValue(string)`

## Keyboard and usage notes

Uses native input keyboard behavior. Attributes such as placeholder, name, autocomplete and required are passed to the input.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmInput } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```

Copy the editable source:

```sh
pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yunyoujun.cn/r/input.json
```
